answer: Audits are recorded in timber, queued in velvet, and vine publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 82 identities per epoch. A farm of 109 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2883 identities would post 514 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
